description: SE5 — Dashboard Big Data Yelp Sprint 3 · Batch + Live · Groupe 1 · SNIA · FSR Rabat

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS "Businesses" FROM bigdata_db.businesses_live
SELECT count(DISTINCT review_id) AS "Avis" FROM bigdata_db.reviews_live
SELECT round(avg(stars), 2) AS "Note" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT review_id, stars FROM bigdata_db.reviews_live)
SELECT round(100 * countIf(is_open = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Ouverts" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT business_id, is_open FROM bigdata_db.businesses_live)
SELECT count() AS "Alertes" FROM bigdata_db.negative_alerts_live
SELECT count() AS "Batch" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes
SELECT toStartOfHour(date) AS time, count(DISTINCT review_id) AS "Avis" FROM bigdata_db.reviews_live WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT received_at AS "Recu le", business_id AS "Business", stars AS "Note", alert AS "Alerte" FROM bigdata_db.negative_alerts_live WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT latitude, longitude, name, city, state, round(stars, 1) AS stars, review_count FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE latitude != 0 AND longitude != 0 AND state IN (${state}) LIMIT 50000

panels.title: 🏙️ Top 15 Villes par Nombre de Businesses

targets.rawSql: SELECT city AS "Ville", nb_businesses AS "Businesses", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy" FROM bigdata_db.axe2_avg_by_city WHERE state IN (${state}) ORDER BY nb_businesses DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: 📈 Évolution Running Avg Note par Mois (agrégé — 3.4M lignes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(makeDate(yr, mth, 1)) AS time, round(avg(running_avg), 3) AS "Running Avg", round(avg(avg_stars_month), 3) AS "Avg Mensuel" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_monthly_running_avg GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 🔒 Taux Fermeture par Classe de Note (4 classes)

targets.rawSql: SELECT stars_bucket AS "Note", closure_rate_pct AS "Taux Fermeture %", closed AS "Fermes", total AS "Total" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_closure_rate ORDER BY stars_bucket
SELECT concat(toString(toUInt8(stars)), ' etoile(s)') AS "Note", count() AS "Total" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE state IN (${state}) GROUP BY stars ORDER BY stars

SELECT round(100 * countIf(has_delivery = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Livraison", round(100 * countIf(has_takeout = 1) / count(), 1) AS "A emporter", round(100 * countIf(outdoor_seating = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Terrasse", round(100 * countIf(accepts_credit_cards = 1) / count(), 1) AS "CB acceptee", round(100 * countIf(bike_parking = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Parking velo", round(100 * countIf(good_for_kids = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Enfants OK", round(100 * countIf(accepts_reservations = 1) / count(), 1) AS "Reservation" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE state IN (${state})
SELECT if(is_open = 1, 'Ouvert', 'Ferme') AS "Statut", count() AS "Total" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE state IN (${state}) GROUP BY is_open

panels.title: 👥 Analyse Sociale — Elite & Ancienneté (données partielles SE3)

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(is_elite, 'Elite', 'Non-Elite') AS "Statut", nb_reviews AS "Avis", round(avg_stars_given, 2) AS "Note Moy", round(avg_text_length, 0) AS "Long. Texte" FROM bigdata_db.axe3_elite_comparison ORDER BY is_elite DESC

panels.title: 📅 Ancienneté du Compte vs Note Donnée

targets.rawSql: SELECT seniority_bucket AS "Anciennete", nb_reviews AS "Avis", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy" FROM bigdata_db.axe3_seniority_analysis ORDER BY seniority_bucket

SELECT date AS "Date avis", business_id AS "Business", stars AS "Note", useful AS "Utile", substring(text, 1, 60) AS "Extrait" FROM bigdata_db.reviews_live WHERE $__timeFilter(date) ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1 BY review_id LIMIT 20

panels.title: ⏰ Analyse Temporelle — Heure / Jour / Mois (données partielles SE3)
🕐 Note Moyenne par Heure de la Journée

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS "Heure", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy", nb_reviews AS "Avis" FROM bigdata_db.axe4_stars_by_hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: 📅 Note Moyenne par Jour de la Semaine

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(day_of_week=1,'Lun',day_of_week=2,'Mar',day_of_week=3,'Mer',day_of_week=4,'Jeu',day_of_week=5,'Ven',day_of_week=6,'Sam','Dim') AS "Jour", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy", nb_reviews AS "Avis" FROM bigdata_db.axe4_stars_by_dow ORDER BY day_of_week
SELECT toDateTime(makeDate(year, month, 1)) AS time, nb_reviews AS "Checkins", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note" FROM bigdata_db.axe4_monthly_trend ORDER BY time

panels.title: 🛠️ Axe 1 — Impact Attributs (WiFi, Prix, Volume Avis)

targets.rawSql: SELECT wifi AS "WiFi", round(avg(stars), 2) AS "Note Moy", count() AS "Nb Commerces" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE wifi != 'unknown' AND state IN (${state}) GROUP BY wifi ORDER BY "Note Moy" DESC

panels.title: 💶 Impact Gamme de Prix sur la Note

targets.rawSql: SELECT price_range AS "Gamme", round(avg(stars), 2) AS "Note Moy", count() AS "Nb Commerces" FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes WHERE price_range != 'unknown' AND state IN (${state}) GROUP BY price_range ORDER BY price_range

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN review_count < 10 THEN '1-9 avis'
        WHEN review_count < 50 THEN '10-49 avis'
        WHEN review_count < 100 THEN '50-99 avis'
        WHEN review_count < 500 THEN '100-499 avis'
        ELSE '500+ avis'
    END AS "Tranche Avis",
    round(avg(stars), 2) AS "Note Moyenne"
FROM bigdata_db.axe1_business_attributes
WHERE review_count > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY min(review_count) ASC

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN nb_competitors_500m = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN nb_competitors_500m <= 3 THEN '1-3'
        WHEN nb_competitors_500m <= 7 THEN '4-7'
        WHEN nb_competitors_500m <= 15 THEN '8-15'
        ELSE '15+'
    END AS "Concurrents 500m",
    round(avg(stars), 2) AS "Note Moyenne"
FROM bigdata_db.business_enriched
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY min(nb_competitors_500m) ASC

SELECT state AS "Etat", round(sum(avg_stars * nb_businesses) / sum(nb_businesses), 2) AS "Note Ponderee", sum(nb_businesses) AS "Total" FROM bigdata_db.axe2_avg_by_city GROUP BY state ORDER BY "Note Ponderee" DESC

panels.title: Villes les plus Divisées (stddev_stars élevé, min 5 commerces)

targets.rawSql: SELECT city AS "Ville", state AS "Etat", nb_businesses AS "Commerces", round(avg_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy", round(stddev_stars, 2) AS stddev_stars FROM bigdata_db.axe2_avg_by_city WHERE nb_businesses >= 5 ORDER BY stddev_stars DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: 🌐 Axe 3 — Influence & Réseau Social (PageRank, Elite, Fans)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN pagerank < 0.0001 THEN 'Faible'
        WHEN pagerank < 0.0005 THEN 'Moyen'
        ELSE 'Eleve'
    END AS "Niveau PageRank",
    round(avg(useful), 2) AS "Votes Utiles Moy"
FROM bigdata_db.axe3_user_review_enriched
WHERE pagerank > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY min(pagerank) ASC

SELECT user_id AS "User ID", round(pagerank, 5) AS "PageRank", fans AS "Fans", friends_count AS "Amis", if(is_elite, 'Oui', 'Non') AS "Elite", round(average_stars, 2) AS "Note Moy Donnee" FROM bigdata_db.axe3_user_enriched ORDER BY pagerank DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT multiIf(fans=0,'0 fans',fans<=5,'1-5 fans',fans<=20,'6-20 fans',fans<=100,'21-100 fans','100+ fans') AS "Fans", count() AS "Utilisateurs" FROM bigdata_db.axe3_user_enriched GROUP BY "Fans" ORDER BY "Fans"

SELECT multiIf(day_of_week=1,'Lun',day_of_week=2,'Mar',day_of_week=3,'Mer',day_of_week=4,'Jeu',day_of_week=5,'Ven',day_of_week=6,'Sam','Dim') AS "Jour", hour AS "Heure", sum(total_checkins) AS "Visites" FROM bigdata_db.axe4_heatmap_global GROUP BY day_of_week, hour ORDER BY day_of_week, hour

panels.title: 🍕 Checkins : Pizzerias vs Gastronomiques par Heure

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS "Heure", type AS "Categorie", total_checkins AS "Visites" FROM bigdata_db.axe4_category_hourly ORDER BY hour, type
